verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a client-side 3D rendering and game engine library. It holds no production data and has no hosted production environment, so a sandbox-versus-production isolation story is a category error for this product. The 'Sandbox' at sandbox.babylonjs.com is a model viewer that merely shares the name. NullEngine headless rendering and the Playground editor are developer testing aids, not isolation from production data, so neither makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
